methods.name: add
methods.description: Appends the specified element to the end of this list. Returns true if the list changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the specified position in this list. Shifts the element currently at that position and any subsequent elements to the right.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Appends all of the elements in the specified collection to the end of this list, in the order that they are returned by the specified collection's iterator.

methods.name: addAll
methods.signature: boolean addAll(int index, Collection<? extends E> c)
methods.description: Inserts all of the elements in the specified collection into this list at the specified position. Shifts the element currently at that position and any subsequent elements to the right.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all of the elements from this list. The list will be empty after this call returns.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Returns true if this list contains the specified element. More formally, returns true if and only if this list contains at least one element e such that Objects.equals(o, e).

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Returns true if this list contains all of the elements of the specified collection.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares the specified object with this list for equality. Returns true if and only if the specified object is also a list, both lists have the same size, and all corresponding pairs of elements in the two lists are equal.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the element at the specified position in this list. Throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if the index is out of range.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code value for this list. The hash code is calculated based on the hash codes of the elements in the list.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the specified element in this list, or -1 if this list does not contain the element.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if this list contains no elements.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in this list in proper sequence.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the specified element in this list, or -1 if this list does not contain the element.

methods.name: listIterator
methods.description: Returns a list iterator over the elements in this list (in proper sequence).

methods.name: listIterator
methods.description: Returns a list iterator over the elements in this list (in proper sequence), starting at the specified position in the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the element at the specified position in this list. Shifts any subsequent elements to the left. Returns the element that was removed from the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from this list, if it is present. Returns true if this list contained the specified element.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes from this list all of its elements that are contained in the specified collection. Returns true if this list changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in this list that are contained in the specified collection. Removes all other elements. Returns true if this list changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the element at the specified position in this list with the specified element. Returns the element previously at the specified position.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in this list.

methods.name: subList
methods.description: Returns a view of the portion of this list between the specified fromIndex (inclusive) and toIndex (exclusive). Changes to the returned list are reflected in this list, and vice-versa.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this list in proper sequence (from first to last element).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this list in proper sequence; the runtime type of the returned array is that of the specified array.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces each element of this list with the result of applying the operator to that element. Errors or runtime exceptions thrown by the operator are relayed to the caller.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts this list according to the order induced by the specified Comparator. All elements in this list must be mutually comparable using the specified comparator.

methods.name: trimToSize
methods.description: Trims the capacity of this ArrayList instance to be the list's current size.

methods.name: ensureCapacity
methods.description: Increases the capacity of this ArrayList instance, if necessary, to ensure that it can hold at least the number of elements specified by the minimum capacity argument.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first element in this list.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the last element in this list.

methods.name: removeFirst
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element from this list.

methods.name: removeLast
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from this list.

methods.name: addFirst
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the beginning of this list.

methods.name: addLast
methods.description: Appends the specified element to the end of this list.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Adds the specified element as the tail (last element) of this list.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head (first element) of this list.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the head (first element) of this list.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds the specified component to the end of this vector, increasing its size by one. (Legacy method)

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the current capacity of this vector.

methods.name: copyInto
methods.description: Copies the components of this vector into the specified array.

methods.name: elements
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of the components of this vector.

methods.name: elementAt
methods.description: Returns the component at the specified index. (Legacy method)

methods.name: firstElement
methods.description: Returns the first component (the item at index 0) of this vector. (Legacy method)

methods.name: lastElement
methods.description: Returns the last component of the vector. (Legacy method)

methods.name: removeElementAt
methods.description: Deletes the component at the specified index. (Legacy method)

methods.name: removeAllElements
methods.description: Removes all components from this vector and sets its size to zero. (Legacy method)

methods.name: setElementAt
methods.description: Sets the component at the specified index of this vector to be the specified object. (Legacy method)

methods.name: insertElementAt
methods.description: Inserts the specified object as a component in this vector at the specified index. (Legacy method)

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of this vector. (Legacy method)

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an item onto the top of this stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the object at the top of this stack and returns that object as the value of this function.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Looks at the object at the top of this stack without removing it from the stack.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Tests if this stack is empty.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns the 1-based position where an object is on this stack.

methods.name: addIfAbsent
methods.description: Appends the element, if not present.

methods.name: addAllAbsent
methods.description: Appends all of the elements in the specified collection that are not already contained in this list, in the order that they are returned by the specified collection's iterator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the specified element to this set if it is not already present. Returns true if this set did not already contain the specified element.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all of the elements in the specified collection to this set if they're not already present. Returns true if this set changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all of the elements from this set. The set will be empty after this call returns.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Returns true if this set contains the specified element. More formally, returns true if and only if this set contains an element e such that Objects.equals(o, e).

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Returns true if this set contains all of the elements of the specified collection.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares the specified object with this set for equality. Returns true if the specified object is also a set, the two sets have the same size, and every member of the specified set is contained in this set.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code value for this set. The hash code of a set is defined to be the sum of the hash codes of the elements in the set.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if this set contains no elements.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in this set. The elements are returned in no particular order (unless this set is an instance of some class that provides a guarantee).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified element from this set if it is present. Returns true if this set contained the specified element.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes from this set all of its elements that are contained in the specified collection. Returns true if this set changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in this set that are contained in the specified collection. Returns true if this set changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in this set (its cardinality).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this set. If this set makes any guarantees as to what order its elements are returned by its iterator, this method must return the elements in the same order.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this set; the runtime type of the returned array is that of the specified array.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first (lowest) element currently in this set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last (highest) element currently in this set.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Returns the greatest element in this set strictly less than the given element, or null if there is no such element.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns the greatest element in this set less than or equal to the given element, or null if there is no such element.

methods.name: ceiling
methods.description: Returns the least element in this set greater than or equal to the given element, or null if there is no such element.

methods.name: higher
methods.description: Returns the least element in this set strictly greater than the given element, or null if there is no such element.

methods.name: pollFirst
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first (lowest) element, or returns null if this set is empty.

methods.name: pollLast
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the last (highest) element, or returns null if this set is empty.

methods.name: descendingSet
methods.description: Returns a reverse order view of the elements contained in this set.

methods.name: descendingIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in this set, in descending order.

methods.name: subSet
methods.signature: NavigableSet<E> subSet(E fromElement, boolean fromInclusive, E toElement, boolean toInclusive)
methods.description: Returns a view of the portion of this set whose elements range from fromElement to toElement.

methods.name: headSet
methods.description: Returns a view of the portion of this set whose elements are less than (or equal to, if inclusive is true) toElement.

methods.name: tailSet
methods.description: Returns a view of the portion of this set whose elements are greater than (or equal to, if inclusive is true) fromElement.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Returns the comparator used to order the elements in this set, or null if this set uses the natural ordering of its elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all of the mappings from this map. The map will be empty after this call returns.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Returns true if this map contains a mapping for the specified key. More formally, returns true if and only if this map contains a mapping for a key k such that Objects.equals(key, k).

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Returns true if this map maps one or more keys to the specified value. More formally, returns true if and only if this map contains at least one mapping to a value v such that Objects.equals(value, v).

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a Set view of the mappings contained in this map. The set is backed by the map, so changes to the map are reflected in the set, and vice-versa.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares the specified object with this map for equality. Returns true if the given object is also a map and the two maps represent the same mappings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the value to which the specified key is mapped, or null if this map contains no mapping for the key.

methods.name: getOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the value to which the specified key is mapped, or defaultValue if this map contains no mapping for the key.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code value for this map. The hash code of a map is defined to be the sum of the hash codes of each entry in the map's entrySet() view.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if this map contains no key-value mappings.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a Set view of the keys contained in this map. The set is backed by the map, so changes to the map are reflected in the set, and vice-versa.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates the specified value with the specified key in this map. If the map previously contained a mapping for the key, the old value is replaced. Returns the previous value associated with key, or null if there was no mapping for key.

methods.name: putAll
methods.signature: void putAll(Map<? extends K,? extends V> m)
methods.description: Copies all of the mappings from the specified map to this map. The effect is equivalent to calling put(k, v) on this map once for each mapping from key k to value v in the specified map.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: If the specified key is not already associated with a value (or is mapped to null) associates it with the given value and returns null, else returns the current value.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the mapping for a key from this map if it is present. Returns the value to which this map previously associated the key, or null if the map contained no mapping for the key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry for the specified key only if it is currently mapped to the specified value. Returns true if the value was removed.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the entry for the specified key only if it is currently mapped to some value. Returns the previous value associated with the specified key, or null if there was no mapping for the key.

methods.name: replace
methods.signature: boolean replace(K key, V oldValue, V newValue)
methods.description: Replaces the entry for the specified key only if currently mapped to the specified value. Returns true if the value was replaced.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value mappings in this map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a Collection view of the values contained in this map. The collection is backed by the map, so changes to the map are reflected in the collection, and vice-versa.

methods.name: compute
methods.signature: V compute(K key, BiFunction<? super K,? super V,? extends V> remappingFunction)
methods.description: Attempts to compute a mapping for the specified key and its current mapped value (or null if there is no current mapping). Returns the new value associated with the specified key, or null if none.

methods.name: computeIfAbsent
methods.signature: V computeIfAbsent(K key, Function<? super K,? extends V> mappingFunction)
methods.description: If the specified key is not already associated with a value (or is mapped to null), attempts to compute its value using the given mapping function and enters it into this map unless null.

methods.name: computeIfPresent
methods.signature: V computeIfPresent(K key, BiFunction<? super K,? super V,? extends V> remappingFunction)
methods.description: If the value for the specified key is present and non-null, attempts to compute a new mapping given the key and its current mapped value.

methods.name: forEach
methods.signature: void forEach(BiConsumer<? super K,? super V> action)
methods.description: Performs the given action for each entry in this map until all entries have been processed or the action throws an exception.

methods.name: merge
methods.signature: V merge(K key, V value, BiFunction<? super V,? super V,? extends V> remappingFunction)
methods.description: If the specified key is not already associated with a value or is associated with null, associates it with the given non-null value. Otherwise, replaces the associated value with the results of the given remapping function.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.signature: void replaceAll(BiFunction<? super K,? super V,? extends V> function)
methods.description: Replaces each entry's value with the result of invoking the given function on that entry until all entries have been processed or the function throws an exception.

methods.name: firstKey
methods.description: Returns the first (lowest) key currently in this map.

methods.name: lastKey
methods.description: Returns the last (highest) key currently in this map.

methods.name: firstEntry
methods.description: Returns a key-value mapping associated with the least key in this map, or null if the map is empty.

methods.name: lastEntry
methods.description: Returns a key-value mapping associated with the greatest key in this map, or null if the map is empty.

methods.name: pollFirstEntry
methods.description: Removes and returns a key-value mapping associated with the least key in this map, or null if the map is empty.

methods.name: pollLastEntry
methods.description: Removes and returns a key-value mapping associated with the greatest key in this map, or null if the map is empty.

methods.name: lowerKey
methods.description: Returns the greatest key strictly less than the given key, or null if there is no such key.

methods.name: floorKey
methods.description: Returns the greatest key less than or equal to the given key, or null if there is no such key.

methods.name: ceilingKey
methods.description: Returns the least key greater than or equal to the given key, or null if there is no such key.

methods.name: higherKey
methods.description: Returns the least key strictly greater than the given key, or null if there is no such key.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of the keys in this hashtable. (Legacy method)

methods.name: elements
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of the values in this hashtable. (Legacy method)

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts the specified element into this queue if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions. Returns true upon success and throws an IllegalStateException if no space is currently available.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the head of this queue. This method differs from peek only in that it throws an exception if this queue is empty.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Inserts the specified element into this queue if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions. Returns true upon success and false if no space is currently available.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the head of this queue, or returns null if this queue is empty.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, or returns null if this queue is empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head of this queue. This method differs from poll only in that it throws an exception if this queue is empty.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Returns the comparator used to order the elements in this queue, or null if this queue uses the natural ordering of its elements.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts the specified element into this queue, waiting if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, waiting if necessary until an element becomes available.

methods.name: remainingCapacity
methods.description: Returns the number of additional elements that this queue can ideally accept without blocking, or Integer.MAX_VALUE if there is no intrinsic limit.

methods.name: drainTo
methods.description: Removes all available elements from this queue and adds them to the given collection.

methods.name: offer
methods.signature: boolean offer(E e, long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
methods.description: Inserts the specified element into this queue, waiting up to the specified wait time if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: poll
methods.signature: E poll(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, waiting up to the specified wait time if necessary after an element becomes available.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers the element to a consumer, waiting if necessary to do so.

methods.name: tryTransfer
methods.description: Transfers the element to a waiting consumer immediately, if possible.

methods.name: hasWaitingConsumer
methods.description: Returns true if there is at least one consumer waiting to receive an element via take() or timed poll().

methods.name: addFirst
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the front of this deque if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions. Throws an IllegalStateException if no space is currently available.

methods.name: addLast
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the end of this deque if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions. Throws an IllegalStateException if no space is currently available.

methods.name: offerFirst
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the front of this deque unless it would violate capacity restrictions. Returns true upon success and false if no space is currently available.

methods.name: offerLast
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the end of this deque unless it would violate capacity restrictions. Returns true upon success and false if no space is currently available.

methods.name: removeFirst
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first element of this deque. This method differs from pollFirst only in that it throws an exception if this deque is empty.

methods.name: removeLast
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the last element of this deque. This method differs from pollLast only in that it throws an exception if this deque is empty.

methods.name: pollFirst
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first element of this deque, or returns null if this deque is empty.

methods.name: pollLast
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the last element of this deque, or returns null if this deque is empty.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the first element of this deque. This method differs from peekFirst only in that it throws an exception if this deque is empty.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the last element of this deque. This method differs from peekLast only in that it throws an exception if this deque is empty.

methods.name: peekFirst
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the first element of this deque, or returns null if this deque is empty.

methods.name: peekLast
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the last element of this deque, or returns null if this deque is empty.

methods.name: removeFirstOccurrence
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from this deque. If the deque does not contain the element, it is unchanged. Returns true if this deque contained the specified element.

methods.name: removeLastOccurrence
methods.description: Removes the last occurrence of the specified element from this deque. If the deque does not contain the element, it is unchanged. Returns true if this deque contained the specified element.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an element onto the stack represented by this deque (in other words, at the head of this deque) if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions. Throws an IllegalStateException if no space is currently available.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops an element from the stack represented by this deque. In other words, removes and returns the first element of this deque. This method is equivalent to removeFirst().

methods.name: descendingIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in this deque in reverse sequential order. The elements will be returned in order from last (tail) to first (head).

methods.name: putFirst
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the front of this deque, waiting if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: putLast
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the end of this deque, waiting if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: takeFirst
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first element of this deque, waiting if necessary until an element becomes available.

methods.name: takeLast
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the last element of this deque, waiting if necessary until an element becomes available.

methods.name: offerFirst
methods.signature: boolean offerFirst(E e, long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the front of this deque, waiting up to the specified wait time if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: offerLast
methods.signature: boolean offerLast(E e, long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
methods.description: Inserts the specified element at the end of this deque, waiting up to the specified wait time if necessary for space to become available.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Returns true if the iteration has more elements. In other words, returns true if next() would return an element rather than throwing an exception.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the iteration. Throws NoSuchElementException if the iteration has no more elements.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes from the underlying collection the last element returned by this iterator. This method can be called only once per call to next(). Throws IllegalStateException if the next method has not yet been called, or the remove method has already been called after the last call to the next method.

methods.name: forEachRemaining
methods.description: Performs the given action for each remaining element until all elements have been processed or the action throws an exception. Actions are performed in the order of iteration.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Returns true if this list iterator has more elements when traversing the list in the reverse direction. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Returns the previous element in the list and moves the cursor position backwards. This method may be called repeatedly to iterate through the list backwards. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: nextIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the element that would be returned by a subsequent call to next(). Returns list size if the list iterator is at the end of the list. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: previousIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the element that would be returned by a subsequent call to previous(). Returns -1 if the list iterator is at the beginning of the list. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the last element returned by next() or previous() with the specified element. This call can be made only if neither remove() nor add(E) have been called after the last call to next or previous. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts the specified element into the list. The element is inserted immediately before the element that would be returned by next(), if any, and after the element that would be returned by previous(), if any. (ListIterator only)

methods.name: sort
methods.signature: static <T extends Comparable<? super T>> void sort(List<T> list)
methods.description: Sorts the specified list into ascending order, according to the natural ordering of its elements. All elements in the list must implement the Comparable interface.

methods.name: sort
methods.signature: static <T> void sort(List<T> list, Comparator<? super T> c)
methods.description: Sorts the specified list according to the order induced by the specified comparator. All elements in the list must be mutually comparable using the specified comparator.

methods.name: binarySearch
methods.signature: static <T> int binarySearch(List<? extends Comparable<? super T>> list, T key)
methods.description: Searches the specified list for the specified object using the binary search algorithm. The list must be sorted into ascending order according to the natural ordering of its elements prior to making this call. Returns the index of the search key, if it is contained in the list; otherwise, (-(insertion point) - 1).

methods.name: binarySearch
methods.signature: static <T> int binarySearch(List<? extends T> list, T key, Comparator<? super T> c)
methods.description: Searches the specified list for the specified object using the binary search algorithm. The list must be sorted into ascending order according to the specified comparator prior to making this call.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of the elements in the specified list. This method runs in linear time.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly permutes the specified list using a default source of randomness. All permutations occur with approximately equal likelihood.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.signature: static void shuffle(List<?> list, Random rnd)
methods.description: Randomly permute the specified list using the specified source of randomness. All permutations occur with equal likelihood assuming that the source of randomness is fair.

methods.name: swap
methods.signature: static void swap(List<?> list, int i, int j)
methods.description: Swaps the elements at the specified positions in the specified list. If the specified positions are equal, invoking this method leaves the list unchanged.

methods.name: fill
methods.signature: static <T> void fill(List<? super T> list, T obj)
methods.description: Replaces all of the elements of the specified list with the specified element. This method runs in linear time.

methods.name: copy
methods.signature: static <T> void copy(List<? super T> dest, List<? extends T> src)
methods.description: Copies all of the elements from one list into another. After the operation, the index of each copied element in the destination list will be identical to its index in the source list. The destination list must be at least as long as the source list.

methods.name: min
methods.signature: static <T extends Object & Comparable<? super T>> T min(Collection<? extends T> coll)
methods.description: Returns the minimum element of the given collection, according to the natural ordering of its elements. All elements in the collection must implement the Comparable interface.

methods.name: min
methods.signature: static <T> T min(Collection<? extends T> coll, Comparator<? super T> comp)
methods.description: Returns the minimum element of the given collection, according to the order induced by the specified comparator. All elements in the collection must be mutually comparable by the specified comparator.

methods.name: max
methods.signature: static <T extends Object & Comparable<? super T>> T max(Collection<? extends T> coll)
methods.description: Returns the maximum element of the given collection, according to the natural ordering of its elements. All elements in the collection must implement the Comparable interface.

methods.name: max
methods.signature: static <T> T max(Collection<? extends T> coll, Comparator<? super T> comp)
methods.description: Returns the maximum element of the given collection, according to the order induced by the specified comparator. All elements in the collection must be mutually comparable by the specified comparator.

methods.name: rotate
methods.signature: static void rotate(List<?> list, int distance)
methods.description: Rotates the elements in the specified list by the specified distance. After calling this method, the element at index i will be the element previously at index (i - distance) mod list.size().

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.signature: static <T> boolean replaceAll(List<T> list, T oldVal, T newVal)
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of one specified value in a list with another. Returns true if list contained one or more elements e such that Objects.equals(oldVal, e).

methods.name: indexOfSubList
methods.signature: static int indexOfSubList(List<?> source, List<?> target)
methods.description: Returns the starting position of the first occurrence of the specified target list within the specified source list, or -1 if there is no such occurrence.

methods.name: lastIndexOfSubList
methods.signature: static int lastIndexOfSubList(List<?> source, List<?> target)
methods.description: Returns the starting position of the last occurrence of the specified target list within the specified source list, or -1 if there is no such occurrence.

methods.name: unmodifiableCollection
methods.signature: static <T> Collection<T> unmodifiableCollection(Collection<? extends T> c)
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the specified collection. This method allows modules to provide users with read-only access to internal collections.

methods.name: unmodifiableList
methods.signature: static <T> List<T> unmodifiableList(List<? extends T> list)
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the specified list. This method allows modules to provide users with read-only access to internal lists.

methods.name: unmodifiableSet
methods.signature: static <T> Set<T> unmodifiableSet(Set<? extends T> s)
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the specified set. This method allows modules to provide users with read-only access to internal sets.

methods.name: unmodifiableMap
methods.signature: static <K,V> Map<K,V> unmodifiableMap(Map<? extends K,? extends V> m)
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the specified map. This method allows modules to provide users with read-only access to internal maps.

methods.name: synchronizedCollection
methods.description: Returns a synchronized (thread-safe) collection backed by the specified collection. In order to guarantee serial access, it is critical that all access to the backing collection is accomplished through the returned collection.

methods.name: synchronizedList
methods.description: Returns a synchronized (thread-safe) list backed by the specified list. In order to guarantee serial access, it is critical that all access to the backing list is accomplished through the returned list.

methods.name: synchronizedSet
methods.description: Returns a synchronized (thread-safe) set backed by the specified set. In order to guarantee serial access, it is critical that all access to the backing set is accomplished through the returned set.

methods.name: synchronizedMap
methods.description: Returns a synchronized (thread-safe) map backed by the specified map. In order to guarantee serial access, it is critical that all access to the backing map is accomplished through the returned map.

methods.name: emptyList
methods.description: Returns an empty list (immutable). This list is serializable. This method is useful for creating empty lists that can be passed to methods expecting a list.

methods.name: emptySet
methods.description: Returns an empty set (immutable). This set is serializable. Unlike the like-named field, this method is parameterized.

methods.name: emptyMap
methods.description: Returns an empty map (immutable). This map is serializable. This method is useful for creating empty maps that can be passed to methods expecting a map.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Returns an immutable set containing only the specified object. The returned set is serializable.

methods.name: singletonList
methods.description: Returns an immutable list containing only the specified object. The returned list is serializable.

methods.name: singletonMap
methods.signature: static <K,V> Map<K,V> singletonMap(K key, V value)
methods.description: Returns an immutable map, mapping only the specified key to the specified value. The returned map is serializable.

methods.name: nCopies
methods.signature: static <T> List<T> nCopies(int n, T o)
methods.description: Returns an immutable list consisting of n copies of the specified object. The newly allocated data object is tiny (it contains a single reference to the data object). This method is useful in combination with the List.addAll method to grow lists.

methods.name: reverseOrder
methods.description: Returns a comparator that imposes the reverse of the natural ordering on a collection of objects that implement the Comparable interface.

methods.name: reverseOrder
methods.description: Returns a comparator that imposes the reverse ordering of the specified comparator. If the specified comparator is null, this method is equivalent to reverseOrder() (in other words, it returns a comparator that imposes the reverse of the natural ordering on a collection of objects that implement the Comparable interface).

methods.name: frequency
methods.signature: static int frequency(Collection<?> c, Object o)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the specified collection equal to the specified object. More formally, returns the number of elements e in the collection such that Objects.equals(o, e).

methods.name: disjoint
methods.signature: static boolean disjoint(Collection<?> c1, Collection<?> c2)
methods.description: Returns true if the two specified collections have no elements in common. Care must be exercised if this method is used on collections that do not comply with the general contract for Collection.

methods.name: addAll
methods.signature: static <T> boolean addAll(Collection<? super T> c, T... elements)
methods.description: Adds all of the specified elements to the specified collection. Elements to be added may be specified individually or as an array. Returns true if the collection changed as a result of the call.

methods.name: Array Creation
methods.description: Creates a new array of the specified type and size. All elements are initialized to default values (0 for numbers, null for objects, false for boolean).

methods.name: Array Initialization
methods.description: Creates and initializes an array with the specified elements. The array size is determined by the number of elements provided.

methods.name: Array Access
methods.description: Accesses the element at the specified index. Index starts at 0. Throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException if index is out of range.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the array. This is a property, not a method, so no parentheses are used.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the array. For arrays of primitives, this creates a true copy. For arrays of objects, it copies references.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the specified array into ascending numerical order using a dual-pivot Quicksort algorithm. This method offers O(n log(n)) performance on many data sets.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the specified array of objects into ascending order, according to the natural ordering of its elements. All elements must implement the Comparable interface.

methods.name: sort
methods.signature: static void sort(int[] a, int fromIndex, int toIndex)
methods.description: Sorts the specified range of the array into ascending order. The range to be sorted extends from index fromIndex (inclusive) to index toIndex (exclusive).

methods.name: parallelSort
methods.description: Sorts the specified array into ascending numerical order using a parallel sort-merge algorithm. This is typically faster than sequential sort for large arrays.

methods.name: binarySearch
methods.signature: static int binarySearch(int[] a, int key)
methods.description: Searches the specified array for the specified value using the binary search algorithm. The array must be sorted prior to making this call. Returns the index of the search key if found, otherwise (-(insertion point) - 1).

methods.name: binarySearch
methods.signature: static int binarySearch(Object[] a, Object key)
methods.description: Searches the specified array for the specified object using the binary search algorithm. The array must be sorted into ascending order according to the natural ordering of its elements.

methods.name: equals
methods.signature: static boolean equals(int[] a, int[] a2)
methods.description: Returns true if the two specified arrays are equal to one another. Two arrays are considered equal if both arrays contain the same number of elements, and all corresponding pairs of elements are equal.

methods.name: deepEquals
methods.signature: static boolean deepEquals(Object[] a1, Object[] a2)
methods.description: Returns true if the two specified arrays are deeply equal to one another. This method is appropriate for use with nested arrays of arbitrary depth.

methods.name: compare
methods.signature: static int compare(int[] a, int[] b)
methods.description: Compares two arrays lexicographically. Returns a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as the first array is less than, equal to, or greater than the second array.

methods.name: mismatch
methods.signature: static int mismatch(int[] a, int[] b)
methods.description: Finds and returns the index of the first mismatch between two arrays, otherwise returns -1 if no mismatch is found. Arrays are considered to mismatch if they have different lengths or if at least one pair of corresponding elements differs.

methods.name: copyOf
methods.signature: static int[] copyOf(int[] original, int newLength)
methods.description: Copies the specified array, truncating or padding with zeros (if necessary) so the copy has the specified length. For all indices that are valid in both the original array and the copy, the two arrays will contain identical values.

methods.name: copyOfRange
methods.signature: static int[] copyOfRange(int[] original, int from, int to)
methods.description: Copies the specified range of the specified array into a new array. The initial index of the range (from) must lie between zero and original.length, inclusive. The final index (to) is exclusive.

methods.name: fill
methods.signature: static void fill(int[] a, int val)
methods.description: Assigns the specified value to each element of the specified array. This is useful for initializing or resetting arrays.

methods.name: fill
methods.signature: static void fill(int[] a, int fromIndex, int toIndex, int val)
methods.description: Assigns the specified value to each element of the specified range of the specified array. The range to be filled extends from index fromIndex (inclusive) to index toIndex (exclusive).

methods.name: setAll
methods.signature: static void setAll(int[] array, IntUnaryOperator generator)
methods.description: Set all elements of the specified array using the provided generator function to compute each element. The generator function receives the index of the element being set.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the contents of the specified array. The string representation consists of a list of the array's elements, enclosed in square brackets.

methods.name: deepToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the deep contents of the specified array. This method is designed for converting multidimensional arrays to strings.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Returns a fixed-size list backed by the specified array. Changes to the returned list write through to the array. This method acts as bridge between array-based and collection-based APIs.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a sequential IntStream with the specified array as its source. This allows you to use stream operations on arrays.

methods.name: stream
methods.signature: static IntStream stream(int[] array, int startInclusive, int endExclusive)
methods.description: Returns a sequential IntStream with the specified range of the specified array as its source. The range extends from startInclusive to endExclusive.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the contents of the specified array. For any two arrays a and b such that Arrays.equals(a, b), it is also the case that Arrays.hashCode(a) == Arrays.hashCode(b).

methods.name: deepHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the deep contents of the specified array. This method is useful for computing hash codes for nested arrays.

methods.name: parallelPrefix
methods.signature: static void parallelPrefix(int[] array, IntBinaryOperator op)
methods.description: Cumulates, in parallel, each element of the given array in place, using the supplied function. For example, if the array initially holds [2, 1, 0, 3] and the operation performs addition, the array holds [2, 3, 3, 6] upon return.

methods.name: parallelSetAll
methods.signature: static void parallelSetAll(int[] array, IntUnaryOperator generator)
methods.description: Set all elements of the specified array in parallel, using the provided generator function to compute each element. The generator receives the index of the element being set.
